auth.note: Every authenticated user gets a `profiles` row; role determines what they can see (see RLS policies in supabase/migrations).

profiles.description: One row per login account (mirrors auth.users). Source of truth for role.

riders.description: Fleet business record for a Bajaji driver -- contract, fee, vehicle. Independent of login: the admin can add a driver here before they ever sign up. `profile_id` links to `profiles` once/if that driver has a login account.

columns.name: text
columns.daily_fee: numeric -- amount due per billing period (see payment_frequency)
columns.location: jsonb {lat, lng}, nullable -- for the future GPS map integration

payments.description: Ledger of collections from riders (cash entries by a manager, or real AzamPay mobile-money collections).

columns.id: text, PK -- our AzamPay externalId / gatewayRef
columns.operator_reference, fsp_reference_id, ga: text, nullable -- set by the AzamPay webhook

payouts.description: Admin-only audit trail of AzamPay disbursements out of the business account.

notes: Row Level Security is enabled on every table; see supabase/migrations for the exact policies.
computeRiderBalance() in src/lib/balance.ts derives each rider's debt/overdraft purely from riders + payments -- no separate balance column to keep in sync.
src/supabase/mappers.ts is the single place that translates Postgres snake_case columns to the app's camelCase TypeScript types.
